data.long_meaning: From the Greek word ἵνικος (hnikos), meaning 'helpful' or 'useful'. In the New Testament, the name Winni is not directly found, but it may be derived from the name Winifred, which is derived from the Welsh words gwen, meaning 'fair, white, blessed', and hawedd, meaning 'good, fair, gentle'. The name Winni carries the meaning “Friend” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Winni usually hope their child will grow to embody friend and live with faith, good character and purpose.
